test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The gardening is done by Anil.

options.text: Anil had been done the gardening
Anil is be done the gardening

solution:
The correct answer is “**Anil does the gardening”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In an active voice sentence, the subject performs the action expressed by the verb. The focus is on the subject who is doing the action. The original sentence given is in passive voice, indicating the action (gardening) is done by the subject (Anil). 
 
• Option 1 ("Anil had been done the gardening") is incorrect because it is not grammatically correct
